scope: Public media recovery reliability, persistent alert observability, and DAIP governance documentation only

security.server_boundary: Cloudflare Functions using Supabase service role

required_owner_tests: Apply the Build 216 migration after Build 214 RLS containment is confirmed
Run Admin Media Health twice with a deliberately harmless missing internal test key and verify it becomes active only after the second failed scan
Restore or upload the internal test asset and verify a passing scan resolves the alert
Open public Local Hero and Service Hub pages in incognito and confirm no blank/default image appears
Complete DAIP-0 decisions before authorizing a DAIP Phase 1 implementation
